content:
siva: Thinking about tightening our postmortem follow-up loop. proposal: 7-day 'close the loop' check-in that confirms owners, blockers, and next steps. short sync + quick doc update. thoughts?
jen: +1 from me. we keep losing track of items after the first week.
alex: Can we make it non-blocking? i.e., 15-min async check on the doc and a brief thread summary.
maria: Love that. also suggest a simple timeline template we can copy into each pm: due date, owner, status, blocker, next action.
siva: exactly. i'm thinking: 1) assign owners in pm, 2) set 7d check, 3) owner posts status in thread, 4) if blocked escalate to remediation queue.
sam: +1. also who rotates incident commander for these follow-ups? we should avoid overloading oncall.
jen: maybe IC of the incident takes first follow-up, then handoff to remediation owner for subsequent cadence.
oncall-bot: Reminder: postmortem created   /postmortem new   https://redwood.internal/postmortems/ID-1234
alex: we should add a tiny checklist snippet in the pm header so follow-ups are obvious. example: 
```
Follow-up checklist (automated):
- [ ] Owner assigned (name)
- [ ] 7d check scheduled (date)
- [ ] Post status in thread (done/pending)
- [ ] Escalate blockers if >7d
```
maria: Also propose a simple reporting metric: % of follow-ups resolved within 30 days. put on the oncall dashboard.
siva: good idea. ops: can we get a small dashboard card? maybe reuse existing remediation tracker table.
oncall-bot: Dashboard card created (mock)   https://redwood.internal/dashboards/remediations
sam: for comms cadence: initial PM + 7d async check + 30d final close comment. anything heavier should be by exception. keeps overhead low.
jen: agree. we should document this in the incident playbook (under 'postmortem follow-up') and make it a required section for sev2+.
siva: I'll draft the playbook blurb and a reusable timeline template. tagging folks for review: @jen @maria @alex. aim to ship by EOW. any last thoughts?
alex: include a link to the remediation owners rota so teams know who to ping for escalations.
maria: add a short sample message owners can paste into the thread when they post status — reduces friction.
siva: perfect. i'll post the draft in #eng-oncall tomorrow and set a one-week pilot. thanks all :thumbsup:
